title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Quest Blue Supply Box - Full Item Box (Control)

preimages.meaning: 蓝箱确认路径原本读取补给箱对象状态。 / The original blue confirmation path reads supply-box object state.
蓝箱确认路径原本加载任务状态全局地址的高半部。 / The original blue path loads the high half of a quest-state global address.
蓝箱确认路径原本准备补给箱状态值 1。 / The original blue path prepares supply-box state value 1.
蓝箱确认路径原本读取任务补给交互使用的浮点状态。 / The original blue path reads floating-point state used by quest supply interaction.
蓝箱确认路径原本准备补给模式参数 0。 / The original blue path prepares supply-mode argument 0.
蓝箱确认路径原本写入补给箱对象状态字节。 / The original blue path writes a supply-box object-state byte.

anchors.meaning: 完整/受限道具箱共用初始化器保存模式参数。 / The shared full/restricted item-box initializer stores its mode argument.
共用初始化器比较受限模式 1。 / The shared initializer compares restricted mode 1.
模式 0 使用完整道具箱菜单状态 6。 / Mode 0 selects full item-box menu state 6.
受限模式 1 使用菜单状态 3。 / Restricted mode 1 selects menu state 3.
共享交互函数比较蓝箱/红箱选择器；零值为蓝箱。 / The shared interaction compares the blue/red selector; zero selects blue.
非零选择器跳到红箱分支，蓝箱继续进入本包覆盖块。 / A nonzero selector branches to red, while blue falls through into this pack's rewrite.
红箱专属路径从这里开始，位于蓝箱覆盖范围之外。 / The red-only path starts here, outside the blue rewrite.
蓝箱完整道具箱调用完成后回到共享收尾路径。 / The blue full item-box call rejoins common cleanup here.
所有任务的蓝色补给箱分派固定传入选择器 0。 / The shared all-quest blue supply dispatch passes selector 0.
蓝箱分派尾调用共享箱子交互函数。 / Blue dispatch tail-calls the shared box interaction.
红色交纳箱分派固定传入选择器 1。 / Red delivery dispatch passes selector 1.
红箱分派尾调用同一共享函数，证明其独立路径保持存在。 / Red dispatch tail-calls the same function, proving its separate path remains present.

license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 覆盖全任务共享蓝箱确认路径并打开模式 0 的完整道具箱；红箱与任务数据保持不变。 / Redirect the shared all-quest blue confirmation path to full item-box mode 0 while leaving red and quest data unchanged.
